captures.notes: The production-streamed town has narrow, tall, fully roofed stacks, pale authored plank decks, staggered rooflines, and supported overhangs. No dark duplicate platform skin is visible.
The requested vertical opening is closed, but several adjacent upper courts combine into a broad rectangular plank field that weakens the building-bounded maze reading.
Roofs and material rendering are sound, while the middle level still reads more as a continuous deck than a collection of narrow passages between inhabited masses.
The upper route is structurally connected and supported, but broad court geometry remains visually dominant in the centre.
A stocked market, external route, nearby facades, and overhead mass form a legible entry. Platform tops use authored boards and every visible room is capped.
The camera is collision-clear but too close to the arched facade to evaluate the reverse route relationship well; this is a capture-quality weakness rather than a construction failure.
Light plank modules tile the walk surface cleanly, the route passes addressed facades, guards follow exposed edges, and the connected stair/platform seams are visually coherent.
The high route is present and supported, but this outward-looking frame gives weak evidence about its onward connection through the settlement.
This hostile cross-axis view is interrupted by stocked market and building mass while retaining a traversable exterior path; no roof, proportion, or plank-material regression is visible.
A broad green horizontal gap remains visible between tall masses. It does not reopen the top-to-ground core shaft, but it weakens the intended closed, winding ground maze.
The top-down view verifies that the former broad see-through-to-ground opening is gone and only bounded holes remain; it also makes the overly rectangular central deck field easy to identify.

findings.evidence: The exact plan closes every raw 3 m core aperture, but several legal route-fused infill patches visually merge into one broad rectangular upper deck.
findings.invariant: Platform infill should close dangerous vertical openings while remaining subordinate to narrow building-bounded passages and separated guarded lightwells.

findings.evidence: The full-resolution cross-axis capture shows a broad grass opening between tall stacks. The exact audit agrees that composition remains below its visual target: frontage_ratio=0.1858 and through_sightline_count=100.
findings.invariant: Inner ground routes should bend between inhabited or overhead mass instead of presenting a broad horizontal opening through the town.

findings.evidence: Both captures pass geometric camera clearance, but one is dominated by a close arched facade and the other looks mostly away from the onward public network.
findings.invariant: Every named review view should clearly expose the complete structural relationship that it claims to inspect.
